Frequently Asked Questions

Are old halogen downlights a fire risk?+

Yes. Halogen globes reach operating temperatures exceeding 300°C. If ceiling insulation slips against an unrated halogen canister, it can ignite structural roof timbers. Modern IC-4 rated LEDs run cool and can be safely covered by insulation.

Can I choose warm white or cool white LEDs?+

Yes. We install tri-colour switchable LEDs (3000K warm white, 4000K natural white, 5000K daylight) so you can customize the ambiance of each room.

Do new LED downlights work with my existing dimmers?+

Older leading-edge dimmers designed for halogens often cause LEDs to flicker or buzz. We install electronic trailing-edge LED dimmers for smooth, flicker-free dimming from 1% to 100%.
